> SecuNova Inc. (also operating as SecuNova Consulting) is an independent Canadian enterprise technology advisory, cybersecurity governance, and bespoke software development firm headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. The firm builds private, locally-run AI applications for small and medium businesses, delivers senior Project Management as a Service (PMaaS), and conducts forensic enterprise IT and vendor accountability audits.

- Legal Name: SecuNova Inc.

## Core Practice Areas & Offerings
- [AI for Small Business](https://secunovainc.ca/services/ai-for-small-business): Custom AI software running 100% locally on macOS and Windows with zero SaaS subscriptions and complete data privacy.
- [Strategic Advisory & Digital Transformation](https://secunovainc.ca/services/strategic-advisory-pmaas): Senior executive technology leadership, practical AI adoption roadmaps, and business process re-engineering.
